name: Tandem paragliding at Bir Billing
description: Twenty-minute flight from Billing with a certified pilot, landing at the Bir meadow.

name: Chokling and Sherabling monastery circuit
description: Two Tibetan monasteries in the colony, with the afternoon prayers at Chokling.

name: Billing sunrise trek
description: Pre-dawn walk up to the take-off site for the Dhauladhar ridge at first light.

name: Solang Valley zorbing and ropeway
description: Ropeway up, zorb down, with the Beas valley behind you.

name: Rohtang Pass day trip
description: Shared cab over the pass, permit included. Closed through winter.

name: Hadimba Temple and Old Manali walk
description: Cedar-forest temple, then the old village and the cafés on the far bank.

name: Kheerganga overnight trek
description: Twelve kilometres up from Barshaini to the hot springs, camping at the top.

name: Parvati riverside afternoon
description: Nothing scheduled. A café by the water and a book.

name: Amber Fort guided tour
description: The mirror hall, Sheesh Mahal and the stepwell below, with a licensed guide.

name: City Palace and Jantar Mantar
description: The palace museum and the eighteenth-century observatory next door.

name: Old city street-food walk
description: Kachori, pyaaz ki kachori and lassi through Chandpole and Johari Bazaar.

name: Lake Pichola sunset boat
description: An hour on the water past Jag Mandir, timed for the light on the City Palace.

name: Bagore Ki Haveli folk performance
description: Rajasthani dance and puppetry in a restored haveli on the ghats.

name: Taj Mahal at sunrise
description: First entry at the east gate, before the crowds and the haze.

name: Agra Fort
description: The red-sandstone fort and the view of the Taj from Musamman Burj.

name: Ganga aarti at Dashashwamedh
description: Evening ceremony from a boat on the river rather than the crush on the steps.

name: Sunrise ghat rowing
description: Out at half past five, downstream past the burning ghats and back.

name: Pangong Tso overnight
description: Over Chang La to the lake, staying in a camp at Spangmik.

name: Thiksey and Hemis monasteries
description: Morning prayers at Thiksey, then Hemis down the Indus valley.

name: Old Goa churches walk
description: Basilica of Bom Jesus and Se Cathedral, with the Fontainhas quarter after.

name: Beach shack seafood dinner
description: Whole fish, prawn balchão and a sunset you did not have to book.

name: Grande Island snorkelling trip
description: Boat out from Vasco with two snorkel stops and lunch aboard.

name: Kathakali performance with make-up session
description: The hour of make-up first, then the performance, at Fort Kochi.

name: Fort Kochi and Jew Town food walk
description: Spice godowns, Mattancherry and the fish grilled where the nets land it.

name: Backwater houseboat, one night
description: Full-board kettuvallam through Kuttanad, moored overnight in the paddy.

name: Canoe through the narrow canals
description: The channels a houseboat cannot reach, with a punt and a local guide.

name: Tea estate walk and factory visit
description: Through the bushes to a working factory, ending with a tasting.

name: Elephanta Caves ferry and caves
description: An hour across the harbour, then the rock-cut Shiva temples.

name: Mohammed Ali Road evening eating
description: Kebabs, malpua and phirni through the Ramzan-season lanes.

name: Humayun's Tomb and Nizamuddin
description: The tomb that rehearsed the Taj, then qawwali at the dargah on Thursday.

name: Old Delhi cycle-rickshaw food ride
description: Chandni Chowk end to end — parathas, jalebi, and Karim's if there is room.

name: Sixteen-kilometre Ganges rafting
description: Shivpuri to Rishikesh, four grade-three rapids and a cliff jump.

name: Golden Temple and langar
description: The parikrama at dawn, then eating in the world's largest free kitchen.

name: Chinatown night-market food crawl
description: Yaowarat from seven, standing up, until you cannot.

name: Grand Palace and Wat Pho
description: The palace complex, then the reclining Buddha and a Thai massage next door.

name: Gardens by the Bay and Supertree show
description: Both conservatories in the afternoon, the light show after dark.

name: Hawker centre tasting: Maxwell and Chinatown
description: Chicken rice, laksa, carrot cake and kaya toast, all under one roof.

name: Tsukiji outer market breakfast walk
description: Tamagoyaki, uni and knife shops, from seven in the morning.

name: Senso-ji and Yanaka old town
description: The temple early, then the low-rise streets Tokyo's bombing missed.

name: Shinjuku Omoide Yokocho evening
description: Six-seat yakitori bars in the alley behind the station.

name: Fushimi Inari before six
description: The full torii climb to the top before the first tour bus arrives.

name: Arashiyama bamboo grove and Tenryu-ji
description: The grove at opening, the temple garden after, and the monkey park above.

name: Louvre, timed entry
description: Pre-booked slot through the Carrousel entrance. Three hours is the minimum.

name: Eiffel Tower summit
description: Lift to the second floor, then the summit lift. Book the first slot.

name: Marais bakery and cheese walk
description: Four stops through the third arrondissement with a Parisian who eats there.

name: Colosseum, Forum and Palatine
description: One ticket, three sites, in that order, starting at opening.

name: Trastevere evening food tour
description: Supplì, carbonara and a gelato that will ruin the others for you.

name: Vaporetto Line 1, end to end
description: The whole Grand Canal by public boat for the price of a bus ticket.

name: Doge's Palace and the Bridge of Sighs
description: The council chambers, the armoury and the prisons across the bridge.

name: Sagrada Família with tower access
description: Timed entry plus one tower lift. Afternoon light through the west windows.

name: Gràcia tapas evening
description: Four bars in the neighbourhood Barcelonans actually drink in.

name: Paragliding over Lake Brienz
description: Take-off from Beatenberg, twenty minutes over the lake, landing in town.

name: Jungfraujoch railway
description: Cog railway to Europe's highest station, through the Eiger.

name: British Museum highlights
description: Rosetta Stone, Parthenon marbles, Sutton Hoo. Free, so go twice.

name: Tower of London and Crown Jewels
description: First entry, jewels before the queue builds, then the Yeoman tour.

name: Burj Khalifa observation deck
description: Levels 124 and 125 at sunset. Book a slot or pay double at the door.

name: Desert dune drive and dinner
description: Afternoon pickup, dune bashing, camel ride and a camp dinner.

name: Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque
description: Both in a morning, with the Basilica Cistern between them.

name: Grand Bazaar and Spice Market
description: Four thousand shops. Bring a list or you will buy a rug.

name: The Met, pay-what-you-wish
description: Two million objects. Pick three wings and accept defeat.

name: High Line and Chelsea Market
description: The elevated park end to end, lunch in the market underneath.

name: Kawarau Bridge bungy
description: Forty-three metres, the original commercial bungy site, since 1988.

name: Milford Sound coach and cruise
description: Long day: through the Homer Tunnel, two hours on the fiord, back by dark.
